methods.label: Remove parentheses and collect terms
methods.explanation:
A minus sign before parentheses reverses the sign of every enclosed term. Simplify each bracket first, then subtract:
\[
\begin{aligned}
[x-(y-x)]-[(x-y)-x]
&=(x-y+x)-(x-y-x)\\
&=(2x-y)-(-y)\\
&=2x-y+y\\
&=2x.
\end{aligned}
\]
The answer is \(\boxed{2x}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{B}}\).
